calvino_stones.stone: After a seven days' march through woodland, the traveler directed toward Baucis cannot see the city and has arrived.
calvino_stones.causal_role: Woodland arrival framing (marchDay 1..7): on the ground beneath dense forest boughs, zero streets or masonry appear—only widely spaced stilts vanishing upward.

calvino_stones.stone: Slender stilts that rise from the ground at a great distance from one another and are lost above the clouds support the city.
calvino_stones.causal_role: Nine widely spaced slender rosewood-terracotta flamingo pilings support 100% of Baucis above the cumulus stratum (earthContactCityMass === 0).
Vertical elevation scrubber (altitude01 0.00..1.00) ascending rung and spiral ladders from mossy woodland floor through cloud rifts to aerial timber belvederes.

calvino_stones.stone: Nothing of the city touches the earth except those long flamingo legs on which it rests and, when the days are sunny, a pierced, angular shadow that falls on the foliage.
calvino_stones.causal_role: Solar weather law: when sunlight01 > 0.35, a geometric lattice shadow of skywalks and eaves projects obliquely across emerald tree crowns (skewed by sunAzimuth); under overcast cloud (sunlight01 <= 0.35), even the shadow vanishes.

calvino_stones.stone: Three hypotheses on the inhabitants of Baucis: that they hate the earth; that they respect it so much that they avoid all contact; that they love it as it was before they existed.
calvino_stones.causal_role: Epistemic triad selector (hatred_of_earth, reverent_avoidance, fascinated_absence) re-framing optical tint, telemetry reading, and absence fascination weight.

calvino_stones.stone: With spyglasses and telescopes aimed downward they never tire of examining it.
calvino_stones.causal_role: Burnished brass achromatic telescope aimed straight down through cloud openings across four calibrated stops (1x Naked Eye, 8x Spyglass, 24x Brass Refractor, 64x Nadir Achromat).

calvino_stones.stone: Examining it leaf by leaf, stone by stone, ant by ant, contemplating with fascination their own absence.
calvino_stones.causal_role: Three living micro-scales (6 leaves with dew & veins at 8x, 6 lichen/quartz stones at 24x, 6 marching wood-ant trails at 64x) whose untouched order shatters if anyone descends a ladder to step on earth.

inner_arch.mechanism: In Baucis equilibrium (inhabitantOnEarth === false), city earth-contact mass is strictly zero save sparse flamingo legs and sunny angular shadow; downward magnification reveals pristine leaves, undisturbed mossy stones, and orderly ant columns, driving absenceFascination > 0.75. Descending a ladder onto the woodland floor (descendLadderToEarth) plants a human bootprint that crushes ferns, muddies stones, and scatters ants—collapsing absenceIntact to false and absenceFascination to 0 until retreating back above the clouds (retreatAboveClouds).

anti_trude_vector.medium: Split-altitude cloud-stilt architectural panorama coupled to a live steerable downward brass spyglass/telescope microscope (1x/8x/24x/64x) and aeolian-woodland WebAudio synthesizer
